paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: Evaluation of our models and LLaMA-3-8B-inst.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," visually compares the performance of two models—LLaMA-3-8B-it (represented by blue bars) and Ours (Iterative RLHF, represented by orange bars)—across nine distinct datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," lists the evaluation benchmarks in left-to-right order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled "Score (%)," ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, indicating the percentage score achieved by each model on each benchmark. Each benchmark has two adjacent bars, one blue and one orange, allowing for direct visual comparison of the two models' scores on that specific task. The tallest bars are for GSM-8K, where both models score approximately 80%, followed by MMLU and HumanEval, where scores hover around 65% for both models. The scores generally decrease for subsequent benchmarks, with TruthfulQA showing scores around 45% for both models, ARC and MBPP around 60%, and LC AlpacaEval-2 showing lower scores around 25% for both models. The MT-Bench (x5) benchmark shows scores around 40% for both models, and Chat-Arena-Hard shows the lowest scores, around 20% for LLaMA-3-8B-it and approximately 30% for Ours. The bars are arranged in the order of the datasets listed on the x-axis and are not sorted by score; there is no visual emphasis or annotation applied to any specific bar.
